main_measure.name: slope of next-day excess return on forecast (return per forecast point)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and weighted mean > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; min 100 cases on 60 distinct days

supporting_check.name: forecast-weighted mean next-day excess return above 0

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the forecast-weighted mean excess return is above 0.
reading: The profile is read from the recorded regime (the detector's components are not recorded and their 60- and 365-bar warm-ups lie outside the windows) and a down day from the raw one-day return < 0; the slope is a pooled OLS with intercept of the next-day excess return (fraction) on the forecast across all coins, with CR1 standard errors clustered by UTC day, and the cases are every bar with forecast > 0 (a 1-bar horizon makes every bar its own grid cell).

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0006748 on the check folds against +0.001071 on every fold
